source_events.event_anchor: recorded H1 first-touch bar open; event level and first-week high/low are frozen from this ledger

prices.h1_confirmation_source: original cached H1 source paths in source experiment sources.csv.gz
prices.scope: all recorded upper events whose symbol has a registered local OKX 15m file and whose recorded touch is literally present in that file; no symbol sampling and no API fetch

entries.reclaim: strict close below the recorded upper 1.618 level; the close of the literal touch bar is eligible because its high touch occurs before its close
entries.literal_touch: 15m high reaches or exceeds the frozen upper level within the recorded H1 touch hour
entries.pending_cancel: cancel before confirmation when any later completed bar in that arm's source timeframe has low at or below the original first-week high
entries.expiry: NY calendar month expiry cancels pending entries; no new entry at or after expiry
entries.fill: open of the next 15m grid bar after the confirming close
entries.entry_validity: skip if next 15m open is at or below the first-week high target

exits.target: closer of the original first-week high and 4% below the actual short entry fill; target price = max(first_week_high, entry_fill * 0.96)
exits.intrabar_ambiguity: VectorBT native OHLC stop kernel; conservative stop-first on simultaneous stop/target touches

costs.stress: separate rerun with adverse 5bp slippage on each market fill; no slippage on resting target fills

portfolio.position_unit: one independent base unit per event/arm; VectorBT cash is isolated per trade column

splits.post_2025: event touch at or after 2025-01-01 UTC

framework: VectorBT native ohlc_stop_choice_nb and Portfolio.from_orders via /Users/zhangzc/.local/bin/vectorbt-python
